strategy.name: StoicTA — Fib Geometry + SBS + Daily Levels

200_sma.name: Simple Moving Average
200_sma.purpose: Primary trend bias — most important level on the chart

daily_levels.note: Levels are read live from TradingView via MCP when available. Cache is refreshed each time Claude Code runs 'run my brief'. The 8am cron uses the cached values from the previous session.

fib_tools.note: Anchor Trend-Based Fib Extension to first pullback. Do not move it unless a bigger sweep invalidates the first pullback.

bullish: Price is consistently above both 20 SMA and 200 SMA
Price is holding above PDC or PDL after retesting it
bearish: Price is consistently below both 20 SMA and 200 SMA
Price is holding below PDC or PDH after retesting it
neutral: Price is between the 20 SMA and 200 SMA — wait for clarity before trading
Price is chopping without a clean reaction at PDH, PDL, or PDC

pre_session_prep: Mark PDH (Previous Daily High) as a horizontal line
Mark PDL (Previous Daily Low) as a horizontal line
Mark PDC (Previous Daily Close) as a horizontal line
Check 20 SMA vs 200 SMA position to set bias for the session
Only take trades in the direction of the bias
long: Setup A — Break and Retest: Price breaks above PDH or PDC with conviction, pulls back to test that level from above, enter long on the retest with stop below the level
Setup B — Swing Failure Pattern (SFP): Price pokes below PDL or PDC but closes back above it — enter long on the reversal, stop below the wick low

Setup C — Fib Geometry (primary model): (1) Identify an impulsive move up. (2) Anchor Trend-Based Fib Extension to the first pullback — first pullback must retrace to at least 50%, ideally 61.8%. (3) Wait for price to extend to the 1.0 (100%) level — this confirms the expansion is real. (4) Enter a limit order long at 50% of the second pullback. Stop goes below the recent swing low. Target 2.618.

SBS overlay: Look for the 1-2-3-4-5 swing breakout sequence. Strongest long entry is at point 5 — the double bottom reversal after the sweep of point 2 stops. Set a buy stop just above the double bottom, stop below it.
short: Setup A — Break and Retest: Price breaks below PDL or PDC with conviction, retests that level from below, enter short on the retest with stop above the level
Setup B — Swing Failure Pattern (SFP): Price pokes above PDH or PDC but closes back below it — enter short on the reversal, stop above the wick high

Setup C — Fib Geometry (primary model): (1) Identify an impulsive move down. (2) Anchor Trend-Based Fib Extension to the first pullback — first pullback must retrace to at least 50%, ideally 61.8%. (3) Wait for price to extend to the 1.0 (100%) level. (4) Enter a limit order short at 50% of the second pullback. Stop goes above the recent swing high. Target 2.618.
SBS overlay: Same 1-2-3-4-5 in reverse. Best short entry at point 5 — double top reversal after sweep of point 2. Sell stop just below the double top.
session_timing: Primary session: New York open (9:30 AM ET) — highest probability setups
Secondary session: London open (3:00 AM ET)
Do not trade away from PDH/PDL/PDC levels — only enter when price is at a level
Do not trade the first 15 minutes of NY open if price action is chaotic

exit_rules: Primary target: 2.618 Trend-Based Fib Extension — take full profit or heavy partial here (~3–3.5R). This is the highest probability reversal or retracement level.
Runner target: 4.23 extension — move stop to break even after 2.618 is tagged, trail stop below structure to hold for this
Home run target: 6.86 extension — only hold for this on clear continuation setups, not retracements
For Break and Retest setups: target the next PDH, PDL, or PDC level on the other side
Alternative: hold into session close if clearly trending — trail stop above/below swing structure lows/highs
Minimum R:R on every trade is 2:1 — skip the setup entirely if the levels do not allow it
After 2.618 is hit, move stop to break even on any runner — do not give back the profit
risk_rules: Maximum risk per trade: 1–2% of account
Maximum 3 trades per day — session ends after 3 trades regardless of outcome
3 losses in a single day = done immediately, close platform and walk away
Down 6% in a week = no trading until next Monday
Hard stop loss MUST be placed in the platform before the trade is entered — no exceptions
Stop loss is fixed at entry — never widen it to avoid a loss
Stop loss can only be moved closer to price (to lock in profit), never further away
Do not take any trade below 2:1 reward-to-risk
notes: Strategy sourced from StoicTA (@StoicTA on YouTube, stoicedge.com). Only 2 indicators needed on-chart (20 SMA + 200 SMA) — fits any TradingView plan including free tier. PDH/PDL/PDC are drawn as horizontal lines (not indicators). Fib Retracement and Trend-Based Fib Extension are drawing tools (not indicators). Primary markets: MNQ, MES, Micro Gold, Micro Silver. Primary session: New York.
